No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this session you learn to assess degrees, funding and language requirements.

It can be booked by one person or by a class. A short form before the session lets the mentor prepare for you.

What it covers

  • Destination selection
  • Funding route
  • Research pitch

How the time is spent

  1. Destination selection 30 min

    Compare faculty, language, funding and research fit.

    You: university matrix

  2. Funding route 60 min

    Scholarship timing and supporting documents.

    You: funding calendar

  3. Research pitch 30 min

    Write to prospective academic contacts appropriately.

    You: email draft

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Diagnose participant goals and constraints based on a pre-session questionnaire.
  • Learn to assess degrees, funding and language requirements.
  • Leave with personalised recommendations and follow-up actions linked to verified sources.

You take away

A personal action plan with dates and checked sources.
